d:
Hasi composed and sung by Ami Mishra with lyrics by Kunaal Verma is a beautiful song from 'Hamari Adhuri Kahaani'.
'Hamari Adhuri Kahani' is written by Mahesh Bhatt and is based on the love story of his parents.
The film stars Vidya Balan, Emraan Hashmi and Rajkummar Rao.
Music available on Wynk, Saavn, Gaana, Hungama, Jive & iTunes
Song Name - Hasi Movie - Hamari Adhuri Kahani
Singer - Ami Mishra
Composer - Ami Mishra
Lyricist - Kunaal Vermaa
